whenToUse: When the relationship between a continuous response and one or more predictors is to be described as an equation — linear, polynomial with interactions, exponential, logarithmic or power — to assess effects, predict, or save a model for optimisation.
name: Regression Analysis
description: Polynomial regression (degree 1–3, interactions), Exponential, Logarithmic, Power
importSourceMissing: The experimental design this model came from is no longer available.
degreeDisabledHint: Degree {deg} requires more than {terms} data points (currently: {n}).
tipR2: Proportion of variance in Y explained by the model. 0 = no explanatory power, 1 = perfect fit. Values ≥ 0.8 indicate a good model.
tipAdjR2: Like R², but adjusted for the number of predictors. Decreases when unnecessary variables are added — better suited for model comparison.
tipPredR2: Predicted R²: How well the model predicts new data (leave-one-out). A large gap to R² suggests overfitting.
tipStdError: Standard error of the regression (S): Average distance of observations from the regression line. Smaller = better fit. In Y units.
tipFStat: F-statistic: Tests whether the overall model is significant (all coefficients jointly ≠ 0). Larger values indicate a significant model.
tipPValueF: p-value of the F-test: Probability of observing the F-statistic under H₀ (no relationship). p < α → model is significant.
tipDurbinWatson: Durbin-Watson statistic (0–4): Tests for autocorrelation in residuals. ≈ 2 = no autocorrelation, < 1.5 = positive, > 2.5 = negative autocorrelation.
errMinData: At least 3 valid data pairs required (currently: {n}).
errInsufficientDf: Too few data points for the chosen model complexity.
designNoticeAliased: {term} is aliased with {with} and was excluded.
designNoticeSaturated: The model would be saturated (no degrees of freedom for error). Excluded: {terms}. Add replicates or center points.
errAliasedTerms: The model cannot be estimated: {term} is aliased with {with}.
errColumnMissing: A selected column no longer exists. Please check the column selection.
noWorksheet: No worksheet in the project. Please create a worksheet with data first.
confRejected: Please enter a value between 0 and 100.
saveBlocked: No model to save: the polynomial type with a fitted result is needed.
saveFailed: The model could not be saved.
importFailed: The experiment could not be taken over.
importUnknown: This experiment does not exist (any more).
